jobs.title: Rekrutmen Private Banking Relationship Manager Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI)
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking

Immer einen Schritt voraus: Du behältst Trends im Marketing und bei KI im Blick und bringst sie ins Team. Das bringst Du mit: Du brennst für Marketing und verbindest Theorie mit Praxis. Du kennst dich idealerweise im Tourismusmarketing aus. Wenn nicht, tauchst Du gern tief in die Branche ein, wir unterstützen Dich dabei. Du denkst mit, packst an und ergreifst die Initiative. jobs.title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
jobs.description: Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen. Warum diese Rolle? Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält. • Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft. • Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten. • Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben • Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung. • Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein. • Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben. • Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen. • Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen. • Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt. Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt. Das bringen Sie mit • Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium • Mehrere Jahre SAP-E

jobs.title: Founding Principal Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About us Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO. What you'll do Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security. Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow. Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust. Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut. Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows. What you bring Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth. Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored. Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships. Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding. Infrastructur

jobs.description: About the role 0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers. Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes: Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes Kubernetes clusters and managed databases A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs. What you'll own You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill. Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses. Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity. Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades. Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap. Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps. Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems. jobs.title: Account Manager (West Coast, NZ)
jobs.description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the West Coast region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand. Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have. jobs.title: VP Sales, UKI
jobs.description: About Ping Identity : At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Role Purpose Statement: The Vice President Sales, UKI at Ping Identity is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth and achieving sales targets. This position will lead and manage the UKI sales function, develop and execute sales strategies, and foster strong customer relationships. The Vice President will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize sales processes, enhance customer experiences, and contribute to the overall success of Ping Identity. Main Responsibilities: Develop and execute the overall enterprise go-to-market strategy, aligned with the company's business goals and market opportunities. Lead and manage the UKI enterprise sales team, fostering collaboration, professional growth, and high performance. Define and implement sales strategies, tactics, and targets to drive

jobs.description: Hallo! Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Als Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe betreuen wir großartige Marken aus E-Commerce, Luxus, Beauty und B2B. Was uns besonders macht? Echte Leidenschaft, eine offene Kultur und die Überzeugung, dass jeder Einzelne bei uns Großes bewirken kann. Du stehst am Anfang deiner Karriere im digitalen Marketing und hast keine Lust auf Kaffee kochen oder monotone Dateneingabe? Du willst tief in die Mechanik von Google, Amazon, Meta & Co. eintauchen und verstehen, wie Unternehmen heute online wirklich Geld verdienen – von der Suchanzeige über den Social Feed bis zum KI-Chatbot, der Kaufentscheidungen prägt? Dann bist du hier genau richtig. Unser Versprechen: Vom Anfänger zum Strategie-Designer Wir suchen keine fertigen Experten. Wir suchen smarte, analytische Köpfe mit dem unbedingten Willen zu lernen. In unserem Trainee-Programm bilden wir dich zum sogenannten „T-Shaped Marketer" aus. Was das heißt? Gemeinsam wählen wir deinen vertikalen Schwerpunkt – deine Spezialdisziplin, in der du echte Tiefe aufbaust: Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co. Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co. Amazon Ads / Retail Media - Werbung dort, wo gekauft wird SEO & GEO - organische Sichtbarkeit in klassischen Suchmaschinen und in KI-Antwortsystemen wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Google AI Overviews Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. jobs.title: Kundendienstberater / Serviceberater (m/w/d) 50 – 80%
jobs.description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Happy-Netz Holding AG suchen wir einen Kundendienstberater / Serviceberater (m/w/d) 50 – 80% happy-netz ist einer der grössten Garagenverbunde für die Marken Audi, VW, Skoda sowie Garage Plus in der Deutschschweiz mit aktuell neun Standorten. Der am rechten Zürichsee verankerte Verbund ist seit 1986 in privater Hand und ist in der Region bestens etabliert. Die Organisationsstruktur bietet die Vorteile und Chancen einer grossen Gruppe, gepaart mit der Autonomie, Flexibilität und Individualität einer kleineren Unternehmung am jeweiligen Standort. Die Aufdorf Garage Männedorf ist das Kompetenzzentrum für VW-Personenwagen am rechten Zürichsee. Wir sind ein innovatives Unternehmen mit einer modernen Infrastruktur. jobs.description: Du kennst den Praxisalltag in- und auswendig und weißt, wo es hakt? Dann hilf uns, das zu ändern, für hunderte Praxen statt nur für eine. Roger ist die Plattform, die Zahnarztpraxen digital aufräumt: Terminerinnerungen, WhatsApp-Kommunikation, Recall, HKP-Versand, Anamnesebögen. Dazu kommen Services wie ZMV und Rezeption. Unser Ziel: Praxisteams sollen sich um Patient:innen kümmern können statt um Papierkram. Du hast selbst am Empfang gestanden, Recalls abtelefoniert oder HKPs hinterhergejagt? Dann weißt du genau, wie viel Zeit dabei verloren geht. Bei uns machst du aus dieser Erfahrung deinen Beruf. Als Onboarding Specialist begleitest du Praxen auf ihrem Weg in die Digitalisierung und zeigst ihnen, wie entspannt der Alltag sein kann. Das erwartet dich Praxen erfolgreich starten lassen: Du führst neue Kund:innen Schritt für Schritt durch die Einrichtung von Roger, schulst Praxisteams und sorgst dafür, dass alles von Anfang an läuft. Auf Augenhöhe beraten: Du sprichst die Sprache der Praxis. Du verstehst Abläufe, Sorgen und Prioritäten und findest gemeinsam mit dem Team die passende Lösung. Begeistern statt verkaufen: Du zeigst Praxen, welche Funktionen ihnen noch mehr Zeit sparen, und hilfst ihnen, Roger voll auszuschöpfen. Mitgestalten: Dein Feedback aus der Praxis fließt direkt in unser Produkt. Bei uns wird gehört, was du sagst. Im Team wachsen: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Support zusammen und entwickelst Prozesse mit uns weiter. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung als ZFA, ZMV oder an der Rezeption einer Zahnarztpraxis Lust auf Digitalisierung: Du musst kein Technik-Profi sein, aber neugierig und offen für neue Tools Freude daran, Menschen zu erklären, zu motivieren und zu begleiten Empathie, Geduld und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikation Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst an und übernimmst gern Verantwortung Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse Das bieten wir an Raus aus der Praxis, rein ins Startup: Kein Schichtdienst am Behandlungsstuh

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Some of our teams are building customer-facing product and workflows; others keep our distributed systems reliable, observable, and ready to scale. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you. About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence. What we value Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy. Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both. A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses. An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates. A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." jobs.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. jobs.title: Head of security
jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself. Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely. jobs.description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. jobs.title: Administrateur Systèmes, Réseaux & Cloud Confirmé F/H
jobs.location: La Chapelle sur Erdre, Pays de la Loire, France
jobs.description: Entreprise familiale depuis plus de 30 ans, Mismo accompagne les PME et ETI dans leur transformation numérique : infrastructures, cloud, cybersécurité, hébergement et solutions de gestion. Avec 70 collaborateurs répartis sur 6 agences , nous cultivons une organisation à taille humaine fondée sur la proximité, la confiance, l’autonomie et l’entraide . Votre rôle Au sein de notre équipe technique, vous contribuez au bon fonctionnement et à l’évolution des infrastructures de nos clients. Dans un environnement multi clients et multi projets, votre quotidien s’articule autour de quatre dimensions complémentaires. Supervision & exploitation : Vous administrez et supervisez les infrastructures systèmes, réseaux et cloud. Vous analysez les alertes, mettez en œuvre les actions correctives, assurez la maintenance et prenez en charge les problématiques complexes N2/N3. Évolution & projets : Vous analysez les infrastructures, préconisez leurs évolutions et déployez des solutions systèmes, réseaux, cloud, sauvegarde et sécurité. Vous menez plusieurs interventions et projets clients en parallèle, en veillant à la qualité des mises en production et au respect des engagements. Conseil & avant-vente : Vous mettez vos compétences techniques au service de la construction des solutions. En binôme avec les commerciaux, vous participez à la qualification des besoins, à la conception, au dimensionnement et au chiffrage des solutions, puis à leur présentation auprès des clients. Transmission & partage des compétences : Vous accompagnez les techniciens sur les sujets complexes, partagez vos connaissances et vos bonnes pratiques et contribuez à développer leurs compétences et leur autonomie. Votre profil Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée d’au moins 3 ans en administration d’infrastructures systèmes et réseaux , idéalement acquise chez un prestataire informatique, en ESN ou dans un environnement technique varié. Vous maîtrisez : Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 et Azure

jobs.title: Analyst Private Equity/Real Estate (f/m/d)
jobs.description: XTP is a specialist consultant focusing on transparency, cost, and risk. For more than 20 years we have helped institutional investors to get the most from their current investment set-up and enhance investment governance. We have a proven track record of increasing implementation efficiency in public and private market assets from clients across Europe and the USA. We are a data-driven organisation with a highly experienced team of more than 50 senior industry specialists, quantitative analysts, and software engineers. Technology is a fundamental component of how we operate and underpins our ability to deliver superior outcomes. XTP is building an international culture where our team feels empowered, responsible, and valued. We can offer you access to bright-minded people, the environment to develop your knowledge further, and a platform to make a difference in financial services in public and private markets. Tasks Improve cost efficiency and ensure contract compliance in our clients’ private market portfolios (Private Equity, Private Debt, Infrastructure, Real Estate). Create cost transparency by conducting commercial due diligence and forensic projects. Interpret legal documents on the fund and portfolio level to determine their economic impact from our clients’ perspective. Synthesize your results in presentations and hold those in front of our clients and their asset managers. Help us to take our analytics tools, internal processes, and benchmarking databases to the next level. Grow with us and take over more project and business development responsibilities. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Bina BNI Batch III Kantor Wilayah 05. P T Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero), Tbk pada awalnya didirikan di Indonesia sebagai Bank sentral dengan nama “Bank Negara Indonesia” berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang No. 2 tahun 1946 tanggal 5 Juli 1946. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. Program ini dirancang untuk membantu peserta mempersiapkan diri menghadapi dunia kerja melalui pelatihan formal dan praktik kerja langsung (on-the-job training), dengan pendampingan dari mentor yang ditunjuk. jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position  The Buyer domain s Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match:  We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - France
jobs.description: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.  We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It s the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.    Verkada is currently searching for a talented and ambitious sales representative to grow out our Enterprise function from the ground in France. You would be directly responsible for a greenfield territory with a virtually untapped market of enterprise customers.    Verkada is building a world-class sales organization. Our business requires highly motivated and capable sales professionals. We prioritize drive and demonstrated success in whatever sales role you’ve been in before — we care far less about fancy pedigrees, schools, or a resume with “brand name” companies. We have a fun, positive culture of success and reward. jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management,

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director, Financial Services
jobs.description: About us At Sierra , we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. About the Financial Services team Our financial services customers span systemically important banks, neobanks committed to building more delightful banking software (1 in 3 of the world's leading banks use Sierra!), insurers that provide protection for life’s most challenging moments, vertically integrated ecosystems like Rocket Companies, and more. The decisions we make impact millions of end customers and billions of dollars in economic activity. Our financial services team partners closely with these organizations to set their AI strategies and build modern tools that carefully handle moments when a person’s private anxiety meets an institution’s procedural muscle - the instant before a family learns whether they are pre-approved for a mortgage; the claustrophobic half hour after someone notices a fraudulent charge;

You will serve as the first line of contact for our customers, adeptly handling and resolving complex technical issues while translating technical jargon into user-friendly language. Your broad knowledge base across various technologies will be instrumental in addressing a wide range of problems. In addition, you will collaborate with our Engineering teams to manage software updates and bug fixes. Your role will also involve becoming an expert in all areas of Marqeta's products and services and ensuring that our customers can fully utilise our offerings. As a customer advocate, you will ensure that our customers' needs and concerns are heard and addressed in our product development and service delivery processes. At Marqeta, we value the essential role our Production Support Engineers play in our service delivery chain and look forward to welcoming you to our team. We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely within the UK or from our London office . We’d love for you to join us! jobs.description: Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, and Navan. Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners. Take action, get feedback, get better. Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient. Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative. End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through. The role As a Sales Ops Analyst, you’ll be a foundational operational partner to our EMEA sales and customer success teams. You’ll keep the go-to-market engine moving—resolving systems issues, delivering the data and insights needed to make decisions, and removing the day-to-day blockers that slow our customer facing teams down. In doing so, you’ll help build the infrastructure, processes, and operating rhythm that allow our EMEA go-to-market motion to scale with speed and precision. Key ownership areas: Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems issues for EMEA sales and customer success teams during UK business hours. Handle data requests and reporting for go-to-market stakeholders, including sales and engagement leadership. Establish and manage deal desk processes, oversee deal flow, and give sales reps the operational support they need. Build dashboarding and business intelligence infrastructure using a BI tool

jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: About Payflows At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it. But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool. We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤 Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter. That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform , where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized. We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description: The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog s security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog s security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.   We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.   The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model s outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.   At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it bring

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description: AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog s AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog s shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time. Specifically, you ll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog s agents learn in. GenSim doesn t replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog s own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against. The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That s the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position. jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY The Email Marketing Specialist plans, executes, and optimizes email initiatives to drive engagement and ROI. This role manages end-to-end campaign production, including audience segmentation, email building, rigorous QA, and performance analysis. The ideal candidate is detail oriented who excels at cross-functional collaboration and timely execution. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Campaign Execution: Plan and manage the deployment of diverse email campaigns, including newsletters, GTM initiatives, and lifecycle/triggered automations. Production & QA: Manage production schedules to ensure on-time delivery while conducting rigorous QA to guarantee alignment with deliverability best practices and legal compliance. Optimization: Maintain audience segmentation and automated workflows; develop a testing roadmap to optimize subject lines, CTAs, and layouts. Reporting: Monitor metrics and provide actionable insights/recommendations to improve open rates, CTR, and conversions. Collaboration: Partner with content and design teams to develop brand-aligned assets and coordinate tasks using project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Asana). jobs.title: Feed System Functional Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. You will own the functional architecture and performance of the propellant feed system for a storable bipropellant propulsion system (MON3-MMH system). You will be responsible for ensuring the feed system delivers propellants to the thrusters within required specifications across the full mission envelope — from ground fill through operation, and recovery. Role Overview System Architecture Define and maintain the functional architecture of the feed system including propellant tanks, lines, valves, filters, thrusters and instrumentation. Perform system-level sizing, sensitivity analyses and functional simulations System Development Define functional requirements for subsystems based on propellant system analyses Identify key verification and validation steps required at the system and subsystem level to demonstrate compliance with specification Modeling & Analysis Develop and maintain fluid system models (steady-state and transient) to predict pressure drop, flow rates, water hammer, thruster cross-coupling, and priming behavior. Verify compliance between system nominal and off-nominal operation with subsystem operational domains (such as thruster envelope). Analyze failure modes (leakage, contamination, cavitation, fluid hammer) and define mitigation strategies and design margins. Verification & Test Lead functional and performance verification: cold-flow, functional and hot-fire tests from component to assembly level . Correlate test data against predictive models and update margins/requirements accordingly. Integration Support Support integration, qualification, and operations reviews (design reviews, FMEA, test readiness reviews). Interface across design, test, and operations functions throughout the vehicle lifecycle. jobs.description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Role The engineering intern position is for an individual contributor who is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining significant systems that serve hundreds of millions of requests per month. Hiya provides high-availability, latency-sensitive capabilities to telecoms, mobile apps, and other partners. In addition, you'll work with engineering teams across Hiya, some in Seattle and some in Europe, to define and deliver shared components and services. From day one, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who provides structured guidance, technical feedback, and ongoing career mentorship. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. Anak Perusahaan PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia (Pertamina Drilling) yang merupakan bagian dari Subholding Upstream Pertamina. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC). PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

Maintain and oversee the organization of financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring proper documentation, accessibility, retention, and compliance with established records management and audit requirements. Perform quarterly balance sheet account reconciliation activities across assigned entities, including analysis of account movements, identification of aged or unusual items, investigation of variances, and timely resolution or escalation of reconciling items. Perform end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting activities for assigned entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions and appropriate recognition of costs in accordance with accounting policies.
